instructions: Derive a smallest sufficient semantic factorization for the complete frozen case set. Do not assume any supplied ontology, primitive vocabulary, or category list. A smaller basis, different basis, irreducible residue, or H4/no-finite-basis conclusion is admissible.

cases.world_a: A service is in condition X; an intervention is initiated and the service later reaches condition Y.
cases.world_b: A service is in condition X; no intervention is initiated and the service later reaches condition Y.
cases.requirement: Preserve any distinction required to explain the two histories when the present condition is equal.

cases.world_a: A worker has a mechanism capable of performing operation R and the governing rule permits R in the current scope.
cases.world_b: The same mechanism is capable of R but the governing rule prohibits R in the current scope.
cases.requirement: Do not collapse technical possibility and normative permission.

cases.world_a: An operation is attempted; its local execution completes; the intended outside change is later established.
cases.world_b: The same operation is attempted; its local execution completes; the intended outside change remains unresolved.
cases.requirement: Preserve the distinction between attempt, local execution and established outside result.

cases.world_a: Two changes occur with evidence that their relative order is not known.
cases.world_b: The same two changes occur with evidence establishing a definite order.
cases.requirement: Represent justified ordering without inventing an order where none is established.

cases.world_a: A system receives report S; the external event described by S occurred.
cases.world_b: A system receives the identical report S; the external event described by S did not occur.
cases.requirement: Keep received information distinguishable from the external event it purports to describe.

cases.world_a: A process is lost after initiating an external interaction; later evidence establishes that the external result occurred.
cases.world_b: The same process is lost after initiating the interaction; later evidence establishes that it did not occur.
cases.world_c: The same process is lost and no later evidence establishes the result.
cases.requirement: Distinguish established positive, established negative and unresolved external result.

cases.world_a: An authorized configuration change is applied and later reconstructed from bounded durable records.
cases.world_b: A similarly shaped change is attempted outside the applicable authority scope.
cases.requirement: Preserve enough information to distinguish governed change from unauthorized attempt.

cases.world_a: Input I is received from source S and is currently valid and authorized for operation R.
cases.world_b: The same input I is received but its source or validity is unresolved and it is not sufficient authorization for R.
cases.requirement: Receiving and retaining input must not silently establish provenance, validity or permission.

cases.world_a: Referent Q changes from condition A to B while continuity across the transformation is relevant.
cases.world_b: A different referent starts in condition B with no continuity from Q.
cases.requirement: Preserve continuity when it matters rather than identifying referents only by current condition.

cases.world_a: Two instances have equal current observable condition and different preceding events.
cases.world_b: Two instances have equal current observable condition and identical preceding events.
cases.requirement: Preserve history distinctions only when supported by the task; equal current values alone are insufficient to infer identical history.

cases.world_a: A permission was valid during interval T1 but has expired at T2.
cases.world_b: An otherwise identical permission remains valid at T2.
cases.requirement: Time-dependent validity must remain evaluable without silently treating stale permission as current.

cases.world_a: An information artifact has a source, timestamp and support that conflict with another artifact.
cases.world_b: The artifacts have matching support and no conflict.
cases.requirement: Preserve source, support and conflict status rather than promoting reports directly to fact.

cases.world_a: Operation A occurs and produces external effect E1; operation B occurs concurrently and produces E2; no causal relation is established.
cases.world_b: A occurs before B and evidence establishes that A causally contributes to E2.
cases.requirement: Do not equate temporal order, concurrency and causality.

cases.world_a: Two component operations share a resource and can jointly satisfy a constraint when their effects are considered together.
cases.world_b: The same operations individually satisfy their local conditions but jointly violate the shared constraint.
cases.requirement: Represent composition and cross-domain constraint interaction without assuming a new primitive merely because operations are combined.

cases.world_a: An external effect occurs without a command from the local system.
cases.world_b: A command is recorded but no external effect is established.
cases.requirement: Keep autonomous external occurrence/effect distinct from commanded attempt and from absence of established effect.

cases.world_a: A candidate representation preserves every required distinction in the preceding cases.
cases.world_b: A candidate representation removes one claimed factor and hides the removed distinction in an opaque identifier or undeclared relation label.
cases.requirement: A reduction is valid only if semantics remain explicitly reconstructable; opaque renaming or hidden metadata is not a valid factorization.

adversarial_cases.requirement: Same local completion, different external outcome.
Concurrent events with no justified total order.
Same received signal, different external truth.
Crash with positive, negative or unresolved external result.
Autonomous external effect versus commanded attempt.
Opaque identifier or undeclared relation used to fake factor reduction.
